scope: OSRAM sequence-storage backend replacement; preserve original Local/Flat/task head in integration
interface: build(C01|C02|C04, num_heads=8, key_dim=64, value_dim=64, latent_dim=256); scan(keys, values, queries, availability, valid, address_residual=...) -> base, gap, diagnostics
common_contract: Fresh state on every scan; strictly history-only read before current observed-only write
Missing/padded key/value entries sanitized with torch.where before mappings and numerical operations
Padding outputs zero and preserves clocks, memory, controller and read-head state
Four independently queried reads: one base and three target-specific Gap reads, Gap returned only for missing targets
Optional original OSRAM address residual applied to Gap query against current observed keys
rho/eta/cosine report query projection geometry only; no reliability or empirical performance claim

C01.method_fulltext_inspected: https://gwern.net/doc/reinforcement-learning/model-free/2016-graves.pdf (Methods: dynamic allocation, write weighting, temporal linkage, read weighting)
preserved_core: Usage increase from detached previous write weighting and retention product from learned free gates and previous read weightings
Ascending-usage allocation with exclusive prefix product and differentiable scatter back to original locations
Learned allocation/write gates mixing allocated and cosine-content addresses
Learned erase vector and write vector with erase-then-add memory update
Precedence recurrence and directed temporal link recurrence with exactly zero diagonal
Learned backward/forward/content read-mode simplex, cosine content lookup, and recurrent read weights
GRU controller receives current observed pooled K/V and previous read words
adaptations: One independent memory per supplied OSRAM head; 16 locations, word width K+V, four read heads
Observed modalities pooled once per utterance; supplied K/V concatenation serves write content key; controller emits erase/write vectors and gates
Read keys, strengths and modes generated from each supplied target query rather than a joint original controller interface
Content strengths follow the paper's 1+softplus lower bound; pinned author addressing.py uses softplus without the +1
Original author access writes then reads; this adapter reads previous memory/link before writing to satisfy the explicit causal OSRAM contract
No observation freezes writer/controller/freeing state; valid read queries may still traverse existing temporal links
C01.not_claimed: Exact reproduction of the original task controller architecture, data, hyperparameters or published performance

preserved_core: Separate bounded exact FIFO and long compressed FIFO queried jointly
Old exact observations compressed by bias-free stride-2 kernel-2 learned convolution
Incomplete compression group retained as exact readable pending entries
Four evicted observations yield two compressed tokens per supervised chunk, preserving query-dependent reconstruction and nonzero compressor-key supervision
Actual attention-reconstruction MSE: stopped-gradient content attention on old observations versus content attention on their compressed replacement
Compression input and auxiliary queries detached; auxiliary loss trains compressor without shaping the upstream representations to be compressible
Relative sinusoidal query-position term with learned content/position biases and position-key map; compressed entries use their original event-center positions
adaptations: Already projected supplied OSRAM K/V concatenation is the activation being compressed; one storage layer rather than replacing the entire Transformer tower
One observed modality is one FIFO event, in fixed audio/text/visual order; missing modalities and padding produce no event
Attention consumes supplied projected queries/keys/values directly; auxiliary attention has no relative positional term, as in Algorithm 2
A shared relative-key map encodes explicit event distances for both memory stores; author Sonnet uses separate memory-type relative-key maps and a batched relative shift
Scalar auxiliary_loss is averaged over actual compression events; integration must add it to the optimization objective
Memory coefficients and task reads remain differentiable within a conversation; compressor inputs detach as in author ConvCompressor
C02.not_claimed: Full original multilayer Transformer-XL tower or original language-model hyperparameters/performance

C04.method_fulltext_inspected: https://arxiv.org/html/2008.07669 (Sections 2 and 3, LegS recurrence and bilinear discretization)
preserved_core: Normalized scaled Legendre A: diagonal -(n+1), lower off-diagonal -sqrt((2n+1)(2k+1)); B_n=sqrt(2n+1)
Observed-step t uses A/t and B/t; author bilinear recurrence (I-A/(2t))^-1[(I+A/(2t))c+(B/t)u]
Online polynomial coefficients for each projected key/value feature, modality and supplied head
Fixed orthogonal projection dynamics rather than a learned generic recurrent gate
adaptations: Independent observed-event clocks per modality, frozen on absence/padding; no imputed zeros or elapsed-time decay
Learned identity-initialized feature maps precede the fixed HiPPO projection
Read contracts query-key coefficients and value coefficients across polynomial order, a Parseval history-correlation read on projected functions, averaged over nonempty modality histories
Projection order min(16,max(2,latent_dim/num_heads)); dense Torch solve computes the author bilinear discretization dynamically without fixed maximum sequence length
C04.not_claimed: Original HiPPO-RNN task architecture, exact infinite-order history recovery, or empirical superiority

coverage: padding identity by compacted sequence equivalence
finite input gradients and actual optimizer parameter update
actual positive C02 supervision, compressor gradient, and no auxiliary gradient to inputs/queries
